main_body: East-facing wooden pew with two red seat cushions running north-south
top_band: Flat seat surface with two red cushions from row 14 to row 42 (29 rows), with only a tiny 3-row south end face at rows 43-45
evidence: Reading column 10 from top to bottom: row 13 is the dark back outline, rows 14-41 are the flat top surface of the pew seat (two large red rectangles on a brown slab), row 42 is a 1px lighter brown front edge line, and rows 43-45 are a tiny 3px south face before the black base line at row 46. The piece reads almost entirely as a top-down plan/slab rather than a 3/4 seat with proper vertical height.

style.evidence: The two red cushions are completely flat 5x10 rectangles of a single red colour with a 1px dark red border, and the wood frame consists of ungrained flat vertical and horizontal strips in 3 brown tones, lacking the surface texture and shading depth of the Beodeul reference props.
